items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I remember John Wilson reviewed a concert of mine.

ctx.x: Oh, I know what I was going to ask. Suppose you were in charge of a magazine or newspaper, what criteria would you

That's a hard thing to say, because to me, I don't go to Broadway plays like I used to. But critics are supposed to write what is seen, in the case of -- for instance, I remember John Wilson reviewed a concert of mine. If he goes to a Beatle concert, he tells you there were millions of people there, and these guys sung that song, they sung the -- he'll tell you that they did the same things they've been doing. But an honest review -- when they review jazz, they don't give an honest review of what was seen, sung.
